purpose: Educational Mizar seed dataset for HippoRAG relation-dynamics evidence.

expected_behavior.valid: Verifier should succeed when local Mizar environment supports the minimal article form.
expected_behavior.invalid: Verifier should fail with a useful error that can be mapped to friction, missing support, contradiction, or indeterminacy.
expected_behavior.ambiguous: Router should prefer clarification over unsupported proof drafting.

non_claims: This dataset does not claim retrieval improvement.
This dataset does not claim quantum computation.
This dataset does not treat quaternion relation traces as formal proof.
